subject: Post-demo: security next steps & request for penetration test report
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: security next steps & request for penetration test report

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the time today — it was helpful to walk through Acme's platform goals and the integrations we discussed. Per our call, I wanted to summarize the security/compliance items we agreed to follow up on and outline what Redwood needs to move forward with a technical evaluation (and procurement).

Recap / asks from Redwood:
- SOC 2 status: please confirm current type (I/II) and expected completion date for any in-progress engagements.
- Data privacy: confirmation of GDPR & HIPAA applicability and whether a DPA is in place.
- Penetration test: we'd like a redacted copy of your most recent external pen test report (high-level findings + remediation status). If you require an NDA or specific upload method, please let us know — we can sign ASAP.
- Vulnerability management: brief doc on cadence (internal scans, external scans), tooling (e.g., Nessus, Qualys), CVSS thresholds you treat as "critical/high", and SLA targets for remediation by severity.
- Vendor security questionnaire: we've attached a short Redwood vendor questionnaire to kick off answers for procurement/security. Completing this will help accelerate the contract review.

Proposed next steps:
1) If possible, please share a redacted pen test report or a summary of findings + remediation timelines within 5 business days.
2) If an NDA is required, we'll send our standard one and can route via DocuSign.
3) Schedule a 30-minute security sync (your security/ops + our security engineer Marcus Lin) to review the remediation plan and any scope questions. Suggested times: Wed 3/11 11:00-11:30 PT or Thu 3/12 09:30-10:00 PT.

Attachments: RI-vendor-security-questionnaire-20260309.pdf (short questionnaire)

Thanks — I appreciate the quick follow-up on this. If easier, Marissa is on the thread for procurement/terms side.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference platform for predictable latency and cost
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, security@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security next steps & request for penetration test report

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers up front and I've attached a redacted copy of our last external assessment. A few notes:

- SOC 2: Acme is currently completing a SOC 2 Type II engagement; expected completion date is 2026-04-20. We can share the report when it's finalized.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We are GDPR compliant and have scoped controls for HIPAA where applicable; we already have a standard DPA for vendor integrations.
- Pen test: attached is a redacted version of the Feb 2026 external pen test (Acme-pen-test-redacted-202602.pdf). We redact customer-identifying assets and exploit PoCs by default. Full reports require an NDA and proof of business need.
- Vulnerability mgmt: we run internal authenticated scans weekly (Nessus) and external scans monthly. SLA targets: Critical = 14 days, High = 30 days, Medium = 90 days. We follow a coordinated disclosure policy; for critical issues we move to emergency patching and customer notification within 48 hours.

We can review the attached questionnaire — I'll have security ops fill the technical sections. Regarding the NDA, procurement prefers DocuSign; please send and we'll expedite. For uploads we use a secured S3 bucket; we'll provide a presigned link once NDA is in place.

Attaching: Acme-pen-test-redacted-202602.pdf

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Security Operations Lead
Acme Corp
laura.chen@acme-corp.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: security next steps & request for penetration test report

Thanks Laura — that's very helpful and exactly the level of detail we hoped to get. A couple quick clarifications and proposed next steps from our side:

1) Thank you for the redacted report. For our internal risk assessment we'll need either the redacted PDF (you already attached) or a short findings summary table that maps each open/closed finding to remediation owner and ETA. If you can provide that summary (even a simple CSV) it will speed internal approvals.
2) We'll route the NDA via DocuSign this afternoon (attached: NDA_Redwood-Acme_20260309.pdf). Please let us know the best person to sign on Acme's side; we can also forward to procurement@acme-corp.com.
3) For the secure transfer, we prefer the presigned S3 link you mentioned once NDA is executed. Please confirm the retention policy for uploaded artifacts (how long reports are stored) and access controls (which Acme users and Redwood users will have access).
4) Marcus (cc'd) will join the security sync — Marcus is our security engineer and will review technical scope. Would you prefer Wed 3/11 11:00 PT or Thu 3/12 09:30 PT?

Attaching: secure-upload-instructions.txt (simple steps we use to upload redacted reports to our secure S3 bucket)

If it's helpful I can also open a HubSpot support ticket to keep the handoff between procurement and security visible; referenced link below.

Thanks again — we'll stand by to sign any agreements and get the sync on the calendar.

Best,
Jonas
